question: Who set a new world record in the men’s 100 m freestyle swimming at Olympic Games Paris, 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pan Zhanle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pan Zhanle**, representing **China**, set a sensational new world record in the **Men’s 100 m freestyle** swimming event at the **Olympic Games Paris 2024**.
 
• The record-breaking performance took place on **July 31, 2024**, at the **Paris La Defense Arena**.
 
• He clocked an extraordinary time of **46.40 seconds**, shattering his own previous world record of **46.80 seconds**, which he had set in **February 2024** during the **World Aquatics Championships** in **Doha**. ***Hence, the statement regarding Pan Zhanle is correct.***
 
• This feat was particularly significant as it marked the **first swimming world record** to be broken during the **Paris 2024** games.
 
• By winning this event, **Pan Zhanle** became the first **Chinese swimmer** in history to win the Olympic gold medal in the prestigious **100 m freestyle** category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kyle Chalmers**:
 
 
• Representing **Australia**, he finished the race in **47.48 seconds** to claim the **Silver Medal** at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**.
 
• He was the gold medalist in the same event at the **2016 Rio Olympics** and a silver medalist at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **David Popovici**:
 
 
• The **Romanian** swimmer secured the **Bronze Medal** in the **100 m freestyle** at **Paris 2024** with a time of **47.49 seconds**.
 
• Earlier in the same Olympic Games, he won the **Gold Medal** in the **Men's 200 m freestyle** event.
 
• He is a former world record holder in the **100 m freestyle**, having set a time of **46.86 seconds** in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **Tom Dean**:
 
 
• A prominent swimmer from **Great Britain**, known for winning two gold medals at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** in the **200 m freestyle** and the **4x200 m freestyle relay**.
 
• He participated in the **Paris 2024** games as part of the **British relay teams** but was not the record setter in the individual **100 m freestyle**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The margin of victory for **Pan Zhanle** was **1.08 seconds**, which is the largest winning margin in the Olympic **100 m freestyle** since the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**.
 
• The **100 m freestyle** is often referred to as the "blue riband" event of the swimming pool, representing the ultimate test of **raw speed** over two lengths of a **50-meter pool**.
 
• The **Olympic Games Paris 2024** swimming competitions were conducted from **July 27 to August 4, 2024**, featuring various disciplines including freestyle, butterfly, backstroke, and breaststroke.
 
• Pan Zhanle's performance is regarded as one of the most dominant displays in modern swimming history, given he improved the world record by a massive **0.40 seconds** in a single race.
